title: I'm building an AI tool that lets you create beautiful video games with no code
author: lukeiamyourpapi
selftext:
The video is a small demo of me creating a prototype of a Ghibli style RPG. I aim to give creators full creative control, I think there's enough slop that exists when AI takes the driving wheel. AI is meant to be a helper, not a replacement.   
  
Would love some feedback if you find this relevant. Happy to share the Discord link for early access and to try early builds out!
